 Kentucky wins second straight exhibition game 
 By WKYT News Staff Published : Oct. 23, 2026 at 9:01 PM EDT | Updated : 17 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LEXINGTON, Ky. (WKYT) - Kentucky improved to 2-0 in its exhibition slate by defeating the Texas Tech Red Raiders, 76-65.
 The Cats were led by sophomore center Malachi Moreno with 15 points and six rebounds. Senior forward Milan Momcilovic also had 15.
 Kentucky led 37-33 at the half behind 10 points from Momcilovic.
 The Cats used a 15-0 run to seize the lead after trailing most of the half. The run was fueled by six Red Raider turnovers.
 Kentucky opened up a 12-point lead early in the second half, but a five-minute scoreless drought allowed Texas Tech to climb back into the game.
 However, the Cats answered the bell and pulled away late.
